text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That it's all right... to have time like this, too......
.............

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's fine to have time like this.
It is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......? ...Um, I'm sorry.
Is there any further explanation?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eh? There isn't?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: There isn't!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, but me, I like super get what Sky-senpai's saying☆
I feel like I get it, kinda! Not that I really do☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, totally! Like, totally? Totally! For real☆
Soooo much!! And it was fun♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like the finding-a-nap-spot thing! Ahaha!
Wasn't it dumb and fun? The rules were a mess too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, oh! Took tons of the kitty too! And then...... a god-tier shot of Ai-chan and the kitty! Wanna see? Wanna see?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And cloud-watching and chillin' that stuff's fine, right?!
Hey hey, let's do it again, 'kay? It was fun!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: 'Cause it was fun...... huhhhhh......

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hold on, hold on! Then next is me☆
Let's all do the thing I wanna do♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's been bugging me this whooole time? We gotta♡
Ai-chan and the gang's—— swimsuit revenge!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on, it's summer? Not buying a swimsuit is wild, no?
Isn't summer basically made for buying swimsuits?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooh... that's a very Pandora-chan way of thinking. On days off, I'm the type who just ends up drawing manga in my loungewear, so, like, total opposite.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what a waste. Days off—— oh myy, yikes♡
It just hit me, bam! This one's for Kiseki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Eh, me!? I think I'd go for something a bit more sporty, though......!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, this one for sure! If you're gonna show off the appeal, it's this.
A hundred billion percent a match for you. Come ooon♡ Please?♡

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(......Ughhhn......! I have had my share of embarrassing moments!
But... yeah. Maybe I should just dive in here, just this once)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Because if I don't...... I'll never understand what Sky-senpai was saying—— and besides,)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
O-okay. I'll go buy that swimsuit!
——Plus, it's really cute!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
See? I told youuuu!!!! It looks sooo good on you♡♡♡
We are the bestttt!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, my face is hot! Eh, am I smiling?
Am I actually managing to smile?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totally♡ I'm fully love-you-ing you, Kiseki-chan!
Anyway, let's take one together! Look at the phone! Woooo☆

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa! I've done cosplay and stuff, but... whoa!
I've hardly ever tried to make myself cute, like, head-on!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(No, but... huh?
W-what is this. How to put it......)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......This might be a little fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ............ Maybe I'll go clothes shopping next time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pheww, that was fun♡ I'm satisfied, satisfied♡
So, what're we doing next? Whose turn is it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then, next is...... Bright-san!
Want to try doing something Bright-san came up with?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh? Mee?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because like me, you seem like you'd be good at it.
Taking it eeeasy, and that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......That is true.
In that case, I——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I should like to walk this road.
Trundle along it until it runs out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Every time I came to training camp, it's been on my mind.
Where this road leads.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......? "No rice balls"? Um, Pandora-sama.
Whatever does that sign mean?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! For real, I'm dying. What even is this shop.
Hey hey, wanna peek inside? Let's gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. It was a lovely bakery.
The whole shop was filled with the smell of wheat.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That shop's something else... with a sign like that, you'd totally think,"What kind of place even is this?" I've gotta learn from that catchphrase game......

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Glug, glug... phew.
Gulp, gulp... hahh.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A drink I've never seen, from a vending machine that might not even work...
I love this kind of thing! An encounter with the unknown, you could say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Shuwa Tea. A carbonated tea...
How terribly humorous it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh myy. So there was a church in a place like this.
I wonder if it's open at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Um, Bright-san. The sun's starting to go down, so...
we should probably figure out how we're getting back......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. ......Only, forgive me, Ai-sama. For quite a while now, I haven't the faintest idea where we are.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eh, really!? You seemed so calm, so I was sure you had some vague sense of where we were......!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My heart is ever so slightly pounding over whether we'll make it back properly.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Worst case, we can just pull up the map on our phones. For as long as we've got today, let's try doing what Bright-senpai wants to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, this is...! Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh, it's the dorms! So this road connected back here! Whoaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. I am relieved.
Familiar scenery is reassuring all on its own, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Somehow, it feels a little like an accomplishment! ......Well, all we did was walk an unknown road and come back to the dorms, but still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even so, it was fun♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Somehow... it was a real do-nothing day today! And yet, why is that? It's strange, not feeling any guilt about it......)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Ah, a LANE from Pandora-chan.
She's sharing my photos——

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............So embarrassing.
Looking at it again. I was totally geeking out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? But somehow... I've got this huge smile.
Honestly, today felt more like I got dragged around——)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ............This kind of thing is nice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ——Alright, me too......!
